{{Quote|The echoes of the Fanged God can be heard throughout the air of Dathomir, from the sound of the snuffling moogs hidden in their lairs to the screeches of the archixes circling their aeries atop the Singing Mountain.|An extract from ''Wild Power'' by Mother Talzin|<ref name="BoS" />}}
'''Archixes''' were winged creatures [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] that dwelt upon aeries atop the [[Singing Mountain (Dathomir)/Legends|Singing Mountain]], around which they circled. The sound they made was one of "screeching." [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomir Witches]] mentioned the creatures in her manifesto, ''[[Wild Power]]'', comparing their screeches to the echoes of the [[Son/Legends|Fanged God]],<ref name="BoS" /> a [[Celestial/Legends|being]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] who resided in the realm of [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]]<ref name="Son Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|son|Son}}</ref> and was worshipped by the Nightsisters as a [[Deity/Legends|deity]]. ''Wild Power'' was one of many writings collected in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] historical book ''[[Book of Sith]]'', assembled by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] sometime between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]].<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Archixes were mentioned in the [[2012]] resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BoS" />
